name: Cody's Gastro Garage (Garden City, UT) Golden Fried Pacific Cod Fish & Chips
brandOrRestaurant: Cody's Gastro Garage (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Flaky Pacific cod fillets are naturally lean, low-residue, and gentle on digestion. The fried coating is light and crispy in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Fish & Chips basket with tartar sauce on the side and a lemon wedge on the side (discard lemon).
watchOuts: Peel off outer batter if feeling sensitive to frying oil
